_comment: Themes are DATA. Adding one is an edit to this file - no CSS and no JS change.
A theme's tokens are written onto document.documentElement.style at runtime, so
there is no stylesheet swap and no flash of unstyled content.
Every theme MUST define the full token set below; the frontend does not merge
against a base, because a half-defined theme that silently inherits is worse to
debug than one that fails visibly.
Brand note: orange is an ACCENT, never a fill. It marks the active nav item, the
focus ring, key values and 1px rules. Filling panels with it would read as a
warning state, which is exactly what --warn is for.

themes.name: CC Dark (Orange Box)
themes.note: Valve-era Steam: flat dark slate, tight 1px borders, dense. Thin HL2 orange accent.

themes.name: CC Light
themes.note: Same structure on a warm paper ground. Orange darkened for contrast on white.

themes.name: Classic Dark (pre-rebrand)
themes.note: The palette the dashboard shipped with, kept so the rebrand loses nothing.

themes.name: High Contrast
themes.note: For a bright plant floor or a projector. Maximum separation, orange kept as the only hue.
